newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Rockshox forecast raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Rockshox forecast raised.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens & Co analyst Pat Snell said he raised his fiscal 1997 (ending March) earnings estimate for RockShox Inc to $1.05 a share from $1.03, and his fiscal 1998 estimate to $1.21 from $1.19.
-- In addition, Snell reiterated a buy rating on the stock.
-- RockShox designs and makes high-performance bicycle suspension products.
-- In a written statement, Snell cited several factors that should lead to solid growth, including the company's entry into new product areas and overseas expansion.
